trials.instruction: Create a NEW original pure-Dart reusable package named aivexus_ascii_slug (Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0), implementing the PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL function String toAsciiSlug(String input) in lib/ascii_slug.dart. Produce a deterministic ASCII-only slug suitable for internal filenames or URL path segments: convert ASCII A-Z to lowercase; keep ASCII a-z and digits 0-9 unchanged; replace every maximal consecutive sequence of other characters (spaces, underscores, punctuation or non-ASCII characters) with a single hyphen, but remove any leading and trailing hyphens. Input that is empty or has no ASCII letters/digits returns an empty string. Never remove a digit or insert double hyphens. For example plain Hello WORLD becomes hello-world. Return a new String, never perform IO or network calls, and use no runtime dependencies. You must write the complete functional implementation yourself, not stubs or a prewritten template. Return only the strict JSON source object required by the system prompt.

Create a NEW original, pure-Dart reusable package named aivexus_delta_codec, SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0, code at lib/delta_codec.dart and behavioral tests under test/. Implement exactly two public functions: List<int> encodeDeltas(List<int> samples), encoding the first sample unchanged and each later entry as current minus previous; List<int> decodeDeltas(List<int> deltas), reconstructing original sample values. Return fresh lists, never mutate arguments. Empty input gives empty output; negative values must work. No external runtime dependencies, network, IO, shell or FFI. Return only the strict JSON files object specified by the system prompt.
